# EduPlay

> Free online English learning games for elementary students (grades 3-7), based on PEP textbook vocabulary. All games run in the browser.

## Games

- [Word Match](https://eduplay.cc/word-match/): Vocabulary matching game.
- [Memory Flip](https://eduplay.cc/memory-flip/): Memory card game.
- [Math Blitz](https://eduplay.cc/math-blitz/): Quick math practice game.
- [Word Family](https://eduplay.cc/word-family/): Word family learning game.
- [Word Pop](https://eduplay.cc/word-pop/): Word popping game.
- [Quiet Garden](https://eduplay.cc/quiet-garden/): A calm garden-themed activity.
